system.description:
Standard Power Progression — 1 Basic, 1 Intermediate, 2 Advanced. You must take the levels of a Discipline in order (all Basic before Intermediate, etc.). Powers from other sourcebooks are grouped under "Expanded Options" in the compendium.

  • Basic (1): Whisper of the Sands
  • Intermediate (1): Tongue of the Tempter
  • Advanced (2): Dark Invocation, Lord of Storms

Base rating-tracker for the Setite Sorcery (The Immanence of Set) Discipline. Set the Rating field to your current level in this Discipline, and drag the individual Basic/Intermediate/Advanced/Elder powers you've learned from the Disciplines & Powers compendium into the Powers list below it.
system.source: Libellus Sanguinis III: Wolves at the Door, Book Three: Serpents
